page.overview:
Who is Annael?

Annael was a Sindarin Elf who lived with his people in the caves of Androth in Mithrim, a region of Hithlum in northern Beleriand. He was known for fostering Tuor in his youth during the late First Age.

Annael was born in Beleriand, probably during the Years of the Trees. He was the leader of a small band of Grey-elves living in the Mountains of Mithrim, having the Swan-wing as his heraldic token.

He fought in the First Battle of Beleriand, one of the first wars of the First Age. After the Noldor's return to Middle-earth, he fought under Fingolfin and Fingon at Dagor Aglareb, the Siege of Angband, the Battle of the Firth of Drengist, Dagor Bragollach, and the Second Assault on Hithlum.

After the Union of Maedhros was formed in the year 468, Annael led a small force of the Grey-elves of Mithrim to take part in the Nírnaeth Arnoediad in the year 472. Annael was the only survivor of from that company who returned to Mithrim. While Rían was hosted by the Grey-elves at Lake Mithrim during the birth of her son Tuor, she asked them to foster him, as she wished to leave and search of her husband Huor. Annael explained to her how Huor had died, and she left the dwelling and went northwards to die on the Haudh-en-Ndengin. Thus, Annael became the foster-father of Tuor during his early years.
